g.text: V10: updating the current record trades off with unmodified-address accuracy

text.style: font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #4b5563

g.text: 64-address maintenance; 32 cycles per seed. Sampled replay is reselected from the full active list each cycle.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #4b5563

g.text: A: thin lines = individual seeds; bold lines = pooled counts. Accuracy includes all unmodified addresses, even if previously wrong.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #4b5563

g.text: B and C exclude the 4 deletion/rebuild cycles (84 ordinary updates across seeds). C: dots = seeds; diamonds = pooled counts.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #4b5563

g.text: Cycle 32 rebuilds both arms identically. These are descriptive optimization repeats; no confidence intervals or significance tests.
